items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: The brother's name was Sterling. His name was Van.

ctx.x: Now, in the meanwhile, his mother was dealing. And
that that he couldn't steal from her, he'd have to go out and buy from the drugstore. He and his brother were stealing all of her dope. The brother's name was Sterling. His name was Van.

Anyway, he got busted and got sent to McAlistor State Penitentiary and left me out there in the streets with an eight-month habit. And I'm a juvenile, I can't go into any drug store and get no morphine. (Laughter).
